prompt: Build a tabs component that uses viewChildren() to query tab panel components in its template and contentChildren() to discover tab items projected by the consumer. Each tab item should have a label input. The tabs component should track the active tab index with a signal and show only the active panel. Use the modern signal-based query APIs.

assertions.text: TabItem has a label defined with input() function (not @Input decorator)
Active tab is tracked with a signal (signal() or computed())
Does NOT import ViewChildren, ContentChildren, or ContentChild decorators
